message.content: Starting triage on the stored max-wait failure — shrinking it to the minimal case.
Shrink isolated a detector failure blocking the signal cycle. I'll confirm the minimal case and examine the violation.
Replay confirmed the failure persists. Now I'll inspect the state at the violation point.
At the limit, EW holds green while NS queues have starved for 201s. I'll check earlier states to pin down the cause.
NS wait is building while EW stays green under the detector fault. I'll trace back to when green locked on.
EW green is persisting past max-green with NS recall pending, so I'll check the phase history to time the lock-up.
This looks like actuated green sticking past max_green during detector_fail. I'll inspect the wait start and run a counterfactual.
Hypothesis confirmed forming: failed E detector keeps EW green stuck. I'll run a counterfactual without it to verify.
Counterfactual with the detector fault removed stays clean. I'll gather final pre-violation states for the report.
